correctness.rationale: Cyclic unit groups give the exact k-th-power images modulo prime powers of 3 and 2; the target M modulo 3^(s+2) supplies a universal lower obstruction; Cauchy--Davenport together with one-variable Hensel lifting gives at most k+1 powers at every prime >=5; CRT proves the global equivalence. The proof treats a<=s+1 separately and explicitly uses k>=s+2. Exact integer checks across 105 prime powers and 458 moduli passed, but the infinite inference uses the symbolic proof alone.

broader_coverage.reasoning: General bounds do not alone imply exactness without the lower obstruction and identification of the sole extremal prime. This proof supplies those arguments. Small 1977 remains a plausible stronger prior source and is named as an unresolved risk.

originality.rationale: The specific global all-moduli divisibility threshold and entire exponential family are not stated in the inspected modern primary sources. The 2023 table contains only the exponent-six value; the 2008 introductory equation is contrary rather than an equivalent covering theorem at the first higher ternary level. This judgment is conditional on accessible literature and does not establish absolute priority.

value.rationale: The exact global maximal modular Waring number is identified for an unbounded family of exponents and, beyond isolated local values, its entire sharp modulus locus is determined by a precise 3-adic divisibility condition. The exceptional one-step jump and uniform dismissal of every other prime form a motivated structural classification extending the 2023 table entry at exponent 6.
